summary: Most Dark-mode enforcement work is implemented: Settings UI no longer exposes Light/System, default theme is Dark, and persisted/backup theme values are normalized to Dark. One notable unrequested change was added (service worker + cache cleanup). A potential gap is that the runtime theme initialization uses `applyTheme` directly and the diff does not show removal/disablement of any existing system-theme listeners elsewhere (only `initializeTheme` removes a stored listener, but it is not shown as used).

missing_requirements.requirement: Lock the application to permanent Dark mode at runtime and remove/disable any system-theme listeners that could toggle modes.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows `themeManager.initializeTheme()` can remove a system theme listener, but the app code shown calls `applyTheme(state.settings)` directly and there is no evidence in the diff that any pre-existing system theme change listeners are removed/disabled globally (or that `initializeTheme` is actually used).

hallucinated_features.description: Service worker unregistration and browser cache deletion on App mount.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest (theme-only change). This introduces new behavior unrelated to locking Dark mode.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx ("Clean up service worker and cache on mount")
